[2026-09-01T03:18:55.089Z] [world] You crouch for the blade — the Hollow Edge, the black mark of the Forgotten Order's enforcers, its steel weeping a faint corruption that fogs the air. But the grip is wrong. It's honed: razored along the inner curve so the handle it
